Description: As a class coordinator, I want to add a student with a name and roll number so I can build the class register. Acceptance criteria: valid name and roll number add a student; blank values and duplicate roll numbers show an error and do not create a duplicate.

As a class coordinator, I want to mark a student present or absent for a chosen date so I can record daily attendance. Acceptance criteria: selecting Present or Absent updates the date-specific status and totals; changing the status updates the existing student/date record.

As a class coordinator, I want to see present, absent, unmarked, and attendance-rate totals so I can review the class at a glance. Acceptance criteria: totals match records for the selected date and update when the date changes.

As a class coordinator, I want to search by student name or roll number so I can find a record quickly. Acceptance criteria: matching students remain visible as I type and clearing the search restores the full list.

As a class coordinator, I want to export the selected date's register as CSV so I can share or archive it. Acceptance criteria: the downloaded file includes roll number, name, date, and Present, Absent, or Unmarked status.

As a class coordinator, I want my changes to remain available after refreshing the page so I do not lose the register during normal use. Acceptance criteria: students and attendance records remain in the same browser after reload.
